findings.title: Claim Form Amount Claimed Differs from Sum of Bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not equal the sum of the hospital total payable and the pharmacy bill total.

findings.title: ICU Stay Duration in Discharge Summary Differs from Bill
findings.detail: The discharge summary states the patient was shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission, implying 2 ICU days, whereas the hospital bill charges for 2 ICU days and 2 room rent days (totaling 4 days of stay).

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission

findings.title: Pharmacy Bill Date Falls Outside Hospital Stay
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is dated 17 Nov 2024, but the pharmacy is located in Bengaluru while the hospital is in Chennai, and outside medicines were purchased before admission or at a distant location.
